A [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''valet''' served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] the [[valet]] was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]], where he invited an individual affiliated with the Empire aboard the Imperial transport ''[[Black Talon]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
